metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. FUJIFILM product information bulletin AF3-178E (2005-09 (print code ESD-05.9)), Fujichrome-T64-Professional-RTP_AF3-178E.pdf, PDF page(s) 7, FUJICHROME T64 Professional [RTP]: https://filmcolors.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Fujichrome-T64-Professional-RTP_AF3-178E.pdf (catalogued at https://filmcolors.org/timeline-entry/40394/) Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): dye densities outside the printed ~390-720 nm (held below, exponential decay above); sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet); neutral balance assumed for 3200 K tungsten (the curve plot is captioned 'Daylight').
